proposals.name: Pyre Bee
proposals.entry:
The Pyre Bee is a large northern bee native to the forests and mountain valleys of Gravoska. Colonies commonly establish themselves inside dead conifers, cliff hollows and abandoned wooden structures.

They are unusually aggressive when defending a hive. Pyre bees collect resinous compounds and nectars from several northern plants, producing a honey with a strange natural heat and a faint tingling sensation upon the tongue. Proper fermentation turns this honey into Thunder-Mead.

Because Thunder-Mead is vital to Gravosk ceremony, industry and warfare, productive pyre-bee country can be strategically important. Whole valleys have become wealthy because of good colonies.

posts.name: Gamemaster Only
posts.entry:
Someone is stealing entire colonies rather than merely harvesting them. The thieves appear to know enough about pyre bees to move hives without killing the queens.

Nobody knows who needs that many bees.
